name: Alice Ice Cream and Coffee
recommendation: Alice started out as an ice cream shop, then a bakery and then a coffee shop. They are excellent at all of this and, arguably, have the best croissants in a town with very high-level croissant game (compare with Il Buco, Andersen’s bakery, Hart bakery and MANY others around town). They also offer delicious lunch options. Definitely worth your time.
